title: Burgundy Lace Corset & Boots
prompt: An original young woman with long, dark wavy hair sits on a dark wooden chest against a deep teal backdrop. She wears a burgundy lace cardigan over a burgundy corset bodice with a plunging neckline and lace trim. A pendant on a fine chain rests at her chest. Dark trousers and tall brown leather boots complete the look. Her expression is calm and direct. Soft, low-key studio light with gentle falloff. Palette of burgundy, deep teal, and warm brown. Dark romantic and editorial, in the style of a fine-art portrait.
workingNotes:
- The lace cardigan over the corset is the defining layer.
- Keep the teal backdrop for a rich, moody contrast.
